recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast 1960s-style album cover featuring a dramatic close-up photograph of a hand snapping fingers against a black background, topped with a vibrant red and yellow technical header and layered with bold, multi-colored display typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Dynamic interaction between the vertical hand gesture and the staggered horizontal text blocks
Color-coded hierarchy separating technical metadata (header) from artist and title
High-contrast lighting on the subject creating deep shadows that blend into the black canvas
coreInvariants: Solid black background for the main body
Top horizontal banner divided into two distinct color blocks
Tight, overlapping or near-touching letterforms in the title

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A single hand occupies the left half of the frame, scaled to approximately 60% of the height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright red artist name spanning the top third of the black area.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the technical header, drops to the red artist name, follows the hand's gesture, and concludes with the staggered title text on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy use of solid black negative space to emphasize the subject's form and the vibrancy of the text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black background providing maximum contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant tomato red used for the artist name and the left side of the top banner.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Creamy off-white and muted mustard yellow for the title and technical details.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds and yellows against a zero-value black background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavyweight sans-serif and high-contrast slab serifs.
letterConstructionRules: Artist name uses an ultra-bold, condensed sans-serif with flat terminals.
Title uses a heavy, rounded slab serif with ball terminals and high stroke contrast.
Header uses an ultra-extended, geometric sans-serif.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'g' in title features a large, expressive loop.
Uppercase 'S' in header is extremely wide and flattened.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between ultra-condensed modern sans and wide, decorative slab serifs.
graphicDevices: Horizontal split-color banner at the top
Thin horizontal rule separating header text

preserve: The staggered layout of the title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the condensed, heavy feel of the artist name.
Captures the chunky, rounded serif feel of the title.
Matches the technical, wide header aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast photograph of a hand with red fingernails snapping fingers, positioned on the left against a solid black background. Include a top banner with a red block on the left and a yellow block on the right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a bold condensed red sans-serif for the artist name at the top. Add a large, staggered three-line title on the right using a heavy slab-serif font in cream and yellow.

verificationChecks: Is the top banner split into red and yellow sections?
Is the title text staggered and overlapping slightly?
Is the lighting on the hand dramatic with deep shadows?

adjustableVariables: Specific colors of the title text
mustRedesign: Any specific logos or brand names in the top right corner
The specific artist name and album title text

mustAchieve: High-contrast chiaroscuro lighting on the hand

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the hand does not have AI-generated artifacts (extra fingers).
Check that the red of the text matches the red of the fingernails.
Verify the 'Stereo' header is ultra-extended and geometric.
Confirm the background is pure black without noise.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine high-contrast photography of a single body part with a split-color technical header and bold, staggered display type in a limited primary palette.
